name: add_shortlink_top_links_endpoint
description: L3 repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): GET /api/links/top aggregation with deterministic ordering and limit clamping; route-shadowing broken registers it after /:slug
prompts: In this express-ts-shortlink repo, add a click leaderboard: GET /api/links/top returns [{ slug, url, clicks }] for the stored links, sorted by click count descending with ties broken by slug ascending. An optional integer query parameter `limit` (default 5) caps the list length; anything that isn't an integer from 1 to 50 answers 400 with { error: 'invalid limit' }. Mind Express route matching: the existing GET /api/links/:slug route must keep working AND must not swallow /top (a request for /api/links/top has to reach the new handler, not be treated as slug 'top'). Clicks come from the store's recorded click timestamps. Everything must still compile under `tsc -p .` strict.
